spoken_summary: A reporter asks Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt if "illegal aliens" should receive Medicaid benefits. Leavitt sidesteps the direct question, instead launching into a critique of the previous "Biden administration." She claims they allowed "tens of millions of illegal aliens" into the U.S., paroling them into the system under "temporary protective status," which she calls a "Band-Aid" and an "abuse of our immigration system." She argues this allows immigrants to get "free benefits" while "hard-working Americans" struggle with a "Biden-induced inflation crisis." She concludes that this is "fundamentally unfair" and her administration will not support it.

central_claim: The Biden administration's immigration policies are fundamentally unfair because they provide free benefits to undocumented immigrants at the expense of struggling, hard-working American citizens.
intended_effect: To generate outrage at the previous administration's immigration policies and portray the current administration as a defender of the American worker.
